steps: Create a TikTok developer app and add the Login Kit and Content Posting API products

Register an https redirect URI that forwards to this gateway (TikTok requires https, static, no query or fragment, under 512 characters): run an https tunnel to the loopback callback and register its URL
Store the client key and secret: switchboard vault set tiktok_client_key and switchboard vault set tiktok_client_secret
Register them with the tunnel URL: switchboard authconfig add tiktok --client-id-ref tiktok_client_key --client-secret-ref tiktok_client_secret --redirect-uri https://YOUR-HTTPS-TUNNEL/oauth/callback
Connect: switchboard connect tiktok --account brand --scopes user.info.basic,video.publish
notes: Observed 2026-10-23 (TikTok Login Kit web doc): authorize at https://www.tiktok.com/v2/auth/authorize/ with client_key (not client_id), response_type=code, a comma separated scope, redirect_uri and state; redirect URIs must begin with https. The doc does not mention PKCE for web apps.

Observed (TikTok user access token doc): POST https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/oauth/token/ with client_key, client_secret, code, grant_type and redirect_uri; code_verifier is required only for mobile and desktop apps. Access tokens last 24 hours, refresh tokens 365 days, and the returned refresh_token may differ from the one sent so the newest must be kept. Revoke is POST https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/oauth/revoke/ with client_key, client_secret and token.
Observed (TikTok user info doc): identity is GET https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/user/info/?fields=open_id,display_name,avatar_url with a Bearer token and the user.info.basic scope.

ADR section 8 (Observed there): an unaudited client can only post privately (SELF_ONLY), at most 5 users may post in 24 hours and posting accounts must be private; public posting needs an audit you submit. Composio has no managed TikTok app either, so this app is always yours.
Scope names other than user.info.basic come from TikTok's scopes overview and were not re-fetched when this file was written.
